Appendix F
BIRD HABITAT AND FOOD HABITS ON THE WESTMORELAND RESOURCES LEASE
List of bird families, subfamilies, and species that occur or may occur on Westmoreland Resources Sarpy Creek lease with notes on habitat and food habits.
Name: Common Loon - Gavia immer
Montana resident in: Sring, Summer.
Habitat: Conniferous lakes.
Foods: Fish, mollusks, frogs, insects.
Miscellaneous: Feeds on fish species considered undesirable.
Name: Grebes - Family Podicipediformes
Montana resident in: Spring.summer, fall.
Habitat: Lakes, ponds, streams, mud, marshes.
Foods: Fish aquatic insects, mollusks and crustaceaus. Also eat their own feathers.
"Miscellaneous: As with the loons, undesirable fish species are a major portion of their diet.
Name: White Pelican - Pelecanus eruthrorhynchos
Montana resident in: Spring, summer.
Habitat: Lakes and marshes.
Foods: Fish and some crustaceans.
Miscellaneous: More than 90% of fish diet is undesirable species.
Name: Double-crested Cormorant - Phalacrocorax auritus
Montana resident in: Spring, summer.
Habitat: Lakes and rivers.
Foods: Fish and crustaceans.
Miscellaneous: Beneficial by removing undesirable fish species.
Name: Herous and Bilterns - Family Ardeidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Marshes, swamps, streams, ditches, ponds - anywhere that food and water are available.
Foods: fish, crustaceans, amphibians, mice, shrews, snakes and turtles.
Miscellaneous: Generally beneficial through removal of undesirable species. May cause damage at fish hatcherys.
Name: Geese - Subfamily Anserinae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Lakes, rivers, marshes, prairies and grainfields.
Foods: Pondweed (1), saltgrass (1), bullrush (2), wheat (2), brome grass (3), wild barley (3).
Miscellaneous: Sought after by sportsmen and bird-watcher alike. Cause some damage to crops when concentrations are high enough.
